description: A study of the meanings, themes and practical lessons of selected short surahs of the Qur'an and the general principles of interpreting (tafsir) the Qur'an.

mcq.questionText: What does the Arabic word 'tafsir' mean?

options.text: Explanation or interpretation of the Qur'an
Recitation of the Qur'an with melody

mcq.explanation: Tafsir comes from a root meaning to clarify or explain; it is the scholarly explanation of the meanings and teachings of the Qur'an.

mcq.questionText: Surah Al-Ikhlas is mainly about which central Islamic belief?
mcq.explanation: Surah Al-Ikhlas declares that Allah is One, eternal, without partners and incomparable, making it a clear statement of tawhid.

mcq.questionText: Surah Al-Fatihah is given a special place in Islamic worship because it is:

options.text: The longest surah in the Qur'an
Recited in every unit (rak'ah) of the prayer

mcq.explanation: Al-Fatihah, the 'Opening', is recited in every rak'ah of the salah and is considered essential to a valid prayer.

mcq.questionText: What main lesson does Surah Al-Asr teach about success in this life and the next?

options.text: That faith, good deeds, and encouraging truth and patience save people from loss
That only scholars will be successful
That success depends on long life

mcq.explanation: Al-Asr swears by time that humankind is in loss except those who believe, do righteous deeds, and advise one another to truth and patience.

mcq.questionText: In Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas, the believer is taught to:

options.text: Seek refuge in Allah from various forms of evil

mcq.explanation: Both surahs begin with 'I seek refuge', teaching the believer to turn to Allah for protection from harm, envy, and whisperings of evil.

mcq.questionText: Surah Al-Ma'un criticises a person who:

options.text: Neglects the orphan and does not encourage feeding the needy

mcq.explanation: Al-Ma'un condemns the one who denies the religion by repelling the orphan and not urging the feeding of the poor, linking true faith to caring for others.

mcq.questionText: The two surahs Al-Falaq and An-Nas are together commonly known as:

options.text: Al-Mu'awwidhatan (the two surahs of seeking refuge)

mcq.explanation: Because both begin with seeking refuge (a'udhu) in Allah, they are jointly called Al-Mu'awwidhatan.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following best states the message of Surah Al-Kawthar?

options.text: Allah has given abundant good to the Prophet, so he should pray and sacrifice to Allah
Wealth should be hoarded for old age
Enemies of Islam will always succeed
Prayer is not required of the wealthy

mcq.explanation: Al-Kawthar tells the Prophet that Allah has granted him abundance (al-kawthar), instructs him to pray and sacrifice for Allah, and that his enemy is the one cut off.

mcq.questionText: When tafsir explains the Qur'an using other verses of the Qur'an itself, this method is called:

options.text: Tafsir of the Qur'an by the Qur'an

mcq.explanation: The most reliable form of tafsir is explaining the Qur'an by the Qur'an, where one verse clarifies the meaning of another.

mcq.questionText: Which surah opens by praising Allah as 'Lord of the worlds' and describing Him as the Most Merciful?
mcq.explanation: Al-Fatihah begins with praise of Allah, Lord of all the worlds, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, Master of the Day of Judgement.

mcq.questionText: Surah Al-Fatihah includes the verse meaning 'You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help.' This teaches:

options.text: Worship and reliance belong to Allah alone
We should ask only created beings for help
Worship may be directed to many gods
Help should never be sought at all

mcq.explanation: This verse establishes pure worship of Allah (tawhid) and that ultimate reliance and seeking of help is directed to Him alone.

mcq.questionText: A reliable principle of tafsir is that the explanation of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) about a verse is:

options.text: An authoritative source for understanding the Qur'an

mcq.explanation: The Sunnah of the Prophet is a primary explainer of the Qur'an, since he was sent to clarify the revelation to the people.

mcq.questionText: Which surah strongly rejects the idea that Allah has a son or any equal?
mcq.explanation: Al-Ikhlas states that Allah did not beget nor was He begotten and that nothing is comparable to Him, rejecting all forms of partnership.

mcq.questionText: The practical application of Surah Al-Ma'un in daily life is best shown by a Muslim who:

options.text: Helps orphans and supports feeding the poor
Ignores those in need around him
Prays only to be seen by people

mcq.explanation: Al-Ma'un links true faith with social responsibility, so its teaching is applied by genuinely helping orphans and the needy.

mcq.questionText: Why is understanding the meaning of the surahs, not only memorising them, encouraged in Islam?

options.text: So that the teachings can be reflected upon and applied in life
So that recitation can be done faster

mcq.explanation: The Qur'an calls people to ponder its verses; understanding the meaning enables a believer to act upon its guidance in daily life.

fib.questionText: The scholarly explanation and interpretation of the Qur'an is called _____.
fib.explanation: Tafsir is the discipline of explaining the meanings and teachings of the Qur'an.

fib.questionText: Surah Al-Ikhlas is best known for teaching the oneness of Allah, known in Arabic as _____.
fib.explanation: Tawhid is the belief in the absolute oneness of Allah, the central theme of Surah Al-Ikhlas.

fib.questionText: The surah recited in every rak'ah of the prayer is Surah _____.
fib.explanation: Al-Fatihah, the Opening, is an essential part of the salah and is recited in each unit of prayer.

fib.questionText: Surah Al-Asr swears by _____ and teaches that humankind is in loss except the believers who do good.
fib.explanation: Al-Asr opens with an oath by time, emphasising its value and the importance of using it for faith and good deeds.

fib.questionText: Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas both begin with the believer seeking _____ in Allah from evil.
fib.explanation: Both surahs begin with 'I seek refuge', teaching reliance on Allah for protection.

fib.questionText: Surah Al-Ma'un teaches Muslims to care for the orphan and the _____.
fib.explanation: Al-Ma'un condemns neglecting the orphan and not encouraging the feeding of the poor and needy.

fib.questionText: Together, Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas are called Al-_____ because both are surahs of seeking refuge.
fib.explanation: Al-Mu'awwidhatan means 'the two of seeking refuge', referring to Al-Falaq and An-Nas.

fib.questionText: In Surah Al-Kawthar, Allah commands the Prophet to pray and to offer _____ to Allah.
fib.explanation: Al-Kawthar instructs the Prophet to pray to his Lord and to sacrifice, showing gratitude for Allah's abundant gift.

fib.questionText: The most reliable method of tafsir is explaining the Qur'an by the _____ itself.
fib.explanation: Explaining one verse of the Qur'an by another is regarded as the soundest form of interpretation.

fib.questionText: Surah Al-Fatihah describes Allah as the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, and Master of the Day of _____.
fib.explanation: Al-Fatihah affirms Allah's mercy and His authority as Master of the Day of Judgement.

tf.questionText: Tafsir means the explanation and interpretation of the meanings of the Qur'an.
tf.explanation: Tafsir is exactly the discipline of clarifying and explaining the Qur'an's meanings.

tf.questionText: Surah Al-Ikhlas teaches that Allah has partners and a son.
tf.explanation: Al-Ikhlas declares that Allah is One, without son or partner, and that nothing is comparable to Him.

tf.questionText: Surah Al-Fatihah is recited in every unit (rak'ah) of the Muslim prayer.
tf.explanation: Al-Fatihah is an essential part of the salah and is read in each rak'ah.

tf.questionText: Surah Al-Asr teaches that all people are in loss except those who believe and do good deeds.
tf.explanation: Al-Asr states humankind is in loss except those who believe, do righteous deeds, and advise one another to truth and patience.

tf.questionText: Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas teach the believer to seek refuge in Allah from evil.
tf.explanation: Both surahs begin with seeking refuge in Allah for protection from various harms.

tf.questionText: Surah Al-Ma'un praises a person who turns away the orphan and refuses to help the poor.
tf.explanation: Al-Ma'un condemns, not praises, such a person and links true faith to caring for the orphan and needy.

tf.questionText: Understanding the meaning of the Qur'an is encouraged so that its teachings can be applied in life.
tf.explanation: The Qur'an invites people to reflect on its verses so that they may act on its guidance.

tf.questionText: The explanation of the Qur'an given by the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is an authoritative source in tafsir.
tf.explanation: The Sunnah is a primary explainer of the Qur'an, since the Prophet was sent to clarify the revelation.

tf.questionText: Surah Al-Kawthar tells the Prophet that Allah has given him abundance and commands him to pray and sacrifice.
tf.explanation: Al-Kawthar mentions Allah's abundant gift to the Prophet and instructs him to pray and offer sacrifice to Allah.

tf.questionText: Al-Falaq and An-Nas are together known as Al-Mu'awwidhatan, the two surahs of seeking refuge.
tf.explanation: Because both open with seeking refuge in Allah, they are jointly called Al-Mu'awwidhatan.

summary.questionText: In one sentence, what is tafsir?
summary.correctAnswer: Tafsir is the scholarly explanation and interpretation of the meanings, themes and teachings of the Qur'an.
summary.explanation: Tafsir clarifies the Qur'an so that its guidance can be understood and applied.

summary.questionText: State the central message of Surah Al-Ikhlas.
summary.correctAnswer: Allah is One, eternal and self-sufficient, He neither begets nor is begotten, and nothing is comparable to Him.
summary.explanation: Al-Ikhlas is a concise and complete statement of tawhid, the oneness of Allah.

summary.questionText: Summarise the main themes of Surah Al-Fatihah.
summary.correctAnswer: It praises Allah as Lord and Most Merciful, affirms worship and seeking help from Him alone, and asks Him for guidance to the straight path.
summary.explanation: Al-Fatihah combines praise, tawhid, supplication and a request for guidance, which is why it is central to prayer.

summary.questionText: What lesson does Surah Al-Asr give about time and success?
summary.correctAnswer: Time is valuable, and true success comes through faith, righteous deeds, and advising one another to truth and patience.
summary.explanation: Al-Asr warns against wasting life and outlines the keys to avoiding loss.

summary.questionText: Explain the purpose of Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas.
summary.correctAnswer: They teach the believer to seek refuge in Allah for protection from outward evils and from the whisperings of evil within.
summary.explanation: Both surahs direct the believer to rely on Allah for protection from all kinds of harm.

summary.questionText: What does Surah Al-Ma'un teach about true religion?
summary.correctAnswer: True religion is shown by caring for the orphan and the needy, not merely by outward acts done for show.
summary.explanation: Al-Ma'un links sincere faith to social responsibility and warns against hypocrisy in worship.

summary.questionText: Summarise the message of Surah Al-Kawthar.
summary.correctAnswer: Allah has granted the Prophet abundant good, so he should be grateful by praying and sacrificing to Allah, while his enemy will be cut off.
summary.explanation: Al-Kawthar reassures the Prophet and teaches gratitude through worship.

summary.questionText: Mention one reliable principle for interpreting the Qur'an.
summary.correctAnswer: The Qur'an should first be explained by other verses of the Qur'an and by the authentic teachings of the Prophet.
summary.explanation: These are the soundest sources of tafsir before relying on the explanations of the Companions and scholars.

summary.questionText: Give one virtue of reciting and understanding the Qur'an.
summary.correctAnswer: Reciting and understanding the Qur'an brings reward, increases faith, and provides guidance for daily life.
summary.explanation: The Qur'an is a source of mercy and guidance, and reflecting on its meaning strengthens a believer's conduct.

summary.questionText: How can the teachings of these short surahs be applied in daily life?
summary.correctAnswer: By worshipping Allah alone, using time wisely, seeking His protection, being grateful, and caring for the orphan and the needy.
summary.explanation: Each surah carries practical guidance that shapes a Muslim's beliefs, worship and treatment of others.

hoq.questionText: A student memorises many short surahs but does not know their meanings. Why do scholars encourage learning the tafsir as well?

options.text: So that the teachings can be understood, reflected upon, and applied in daily life
Because memorisation without understanding is forbidden in Islam
Because the meanings change the wording of the surahs

hoq.explanation: Memorisation is praiseworthy, but understanding the meaning through tafsir allows a believer to act upon the Qur'an's guidance, which is its ultimate purpose.

hoq.questionText: A person prays regularly in public but ignores orphans and refuses to help the poor. Which surah most directly addresses this behaviour, and what does it teach?

options.text: Surah Al-Ma'un, which warns that neglecting the needy and praying for show contradicts true faith
Surah Al-Ikhlas, which teaches the oneness of Allah
Surah Al-Kawthar, which speaks of Allah's abundant gift
Surah Al-Falaq, which is about seeking refuge from evil

hoq.explanation: Al-Ma'un links genuine religion with kindness to the orphan and needy and condemns worship done only to be seen by people.

hoq.questionText: Two people disagree about the meaning of a Qur'anic verse, each relying only on personal opinion. According to sound principles of tafsir, what should they do first?

options.text: Look to other verses of the Qur'an and the authentic teachings of the Prophet for clarification
Accept whichever opinion sounds more pleasing
Decide the matter by counting who has more supporters

hoq.explanation: Reliable tafsir explains the Qur'an by the Qur'an and by the Sunnah before depending on personal reasoning, which guards against error.
